title: Snapshot
description: Reclaim finance snapshot v2, for the frozen design. Published beside v1. Definitions, including Likely left, are in snapshot-v2.md. Consumers ignore unknown fields. Anything real data cannot supply is null, with a reason in `absent`.

stale_after_hours.description: Numbers are stale when now minus manifest.generated_at is over this. See snapshot-v2.md.

built_at.description: The build time is not in here, so a rebuild stays byte-identical. Read it from the manifest.

Figure.description: One number and everything needed to trust it. `value` is always an integer in `unit`: paise, never a float. The UI only chooses colours from `status`.

rule.description: Id in the rules file that set `status`.

basis.description: How it was worked out, in words. Always fixed text, never payload text.

spread.description: Optional median and plus-or-minus variance, in `unit`, with the months backtested and how often the real month end landed inside, in basis points.

usual_low.description: Where a usual month lands, low end, in `unit`. The app prints this range, never a ±. Spending never goes below 0; a balance may, which means overdrawn. Optional.

key.description: Source key of a payment that happened; null for one expected.

due_date.description: The day it is really due. `date` is when it can still leave, so an overdue card bill keeps its lateness here. Null on a spend.

time.description: IST clock time where an SMS gave one. A statement alone gives a date.

category.description: A group from the ledger taxonomy with its detail: Food or Food:Groceries. Null only where no ledger account says, such as a plan.

brand.description: Null while the merchant is unnamed or only suggested: a guess earns no logo.

may_be_paid.description: A bank debit near this bill's balance, not proven to be a card payment. It clears nothing. Absent when none.

unmatched_off.description: bills.upcoming only: paise of a card payment that named no card, set against this bill. amount is net of it. Absent when none.

spend_kind.description: Fixed cost, variable spending or a large one-off, set on the server. snapshot-v2.md, "Fixed, variable, one-off". Absent on a row from a build before this field.

spend_kind_reason.description: Why, as a code. spend.allocation.reasons has the words.

spend_kind_source.description: rule: worked out. owner: a correction with spend_kind said so.

purchased.description: spend.days[].items[] only: what a receipt or order lists for this payment. Metadata: it changes no amount. Absent when nothing holds it.

reason.description: One plain line when not ok. Fixed text and counts only.

brand.description: Null while the merchant is unnamed or only suggested: a guess earns no logo.
Null while the merchant is unnamed or only suggested: a guess earns no logo.

paid_not_posted.description: A bank debit that cleared this card's open bill, whose card side has not arrived. Absent when none.

paid_inferred.description: True when that clearing rests on card wording or rail plus a near balance, not an exact amount. Absent otherwise.

label.description: A fuller name for the card than `card`, when its statement prints fewer digits than its messages do. Absent otherwise.

billed.description: Paise a statement has billed, less payments since. Negative when overpaid.

not_billed.description: Paise charged since the statement and still owed: no bill says so yet.

owed_split.description: The row's balance, split. billed + not_billed = statement + since - paid_not_posted.

month_ends.description: Up to 12 finished months, oldest first. Under 12: nothing is green.

liquid.description: Cash plus stocks and funds you could sell within a week.

before_salary_ends.description: Up to 12 real balances, each the day before a salary landed, oldest first. The bar for `before_salary`: no salary in either. Optional, as `before_salary` is.

payment_unmatched.description: `owed_total` is each card's statement + since - paid_not_posted, less this.

billed.description: Paise a statement has billed, less payments since. Negative when overpaid.

not_billed.description: Paise charged since the statement and still owed: no bill says so yet.

owed_split.description: owed_total, split. billed + not_billed = owed_total.value. Bills and the Line count billed; Owe counts both.

Position.description: What do I have and owe, right now?

id.description: The saved expense, in `plan_inputs.expenses`. Null on a line from the older plans file that is not one.

likely_left.description: The hero. The expected bank balance at the close of `month_end`: cash + pay_included - due - usual_spend, rounded to the rule's step. A salary expected on or after `month_end` is NOT in it. Null when history is too short: say so, show no number.

pay_included.description: A salary expected after today and before `month_end`, which is inside `likely_left`. Null when none is.

next_salary.description: The first salary NOT inside `likely_left`: the Salary row after it. Its date is never before `month_end`. Null without a regular salary.

before_salary.description: The hero since 2026-11-03: what should be in the bank on the day before the next salary. Optional, so a snapshot from before it stays valid. See snapshot-v2.md.

likely_bills.description: Bills after the next salary. Apart from Likely left, which holds none of them. Optional, so a snapshot from before it stays valid.

Forecast.description: What will be left at month end? v1's `base`, `pay` and `pay_date` are gone, because `base` could include a salary landing on the last day.

state.description: no_data: outside what the data covers. It must never read as no spending.

complete.description: The whole month is inside the data and before the as-of month. Up to the last 12 such months. Null `spent`: before the data begins.

first_day.description: The first day anything is known about.

data_through.description: The last day anything is known about, up to as_of.

month_end_forecast.description: All spending by month end: spent so far plus the median of the same days left.

Spend.description: How much am I spending, against my usual by this day? Baselines exclude one-offs, Uncategorized and Splitwise.

Suggestion.description: A deterministic guess the owner can accept in one tap. It never moves money until confirmed. `reason` is fixed text, never payload text.

group.description: A correction's `group`: a top group, optionally with a detail, such as Food:Groceries.

key.description: What a correction for this names: an alias key when `scope` is similar, one payment's source key when `scope` is one.

raw.description: The sanitised name before cleaning, so the owner can recognise it.

merchant_id.description: The first correction's id, or the merge target's. Never derived from the name.

brand.description: Null while the merchant is unnamed or only suggested: a guess earns no logo.

category.description: A group from the ledger taxonomy with its detail: Food or Food:Groceries. Null only where no ledger account says, such as a plan.

distinct_names.description: How many different names this group's rows carry. Over 1, one correction would rename different people, so the app refuses it.

month_total.description: Unnamed money this month: the base for naming progress. `total` spans 6 months.

confidence.description: How the name and group were decided: a correction, merchants.tsv, a rule, a suggestion waiting for the owner, or nothing yet.

brand.description: Null while the merchant is unnamed or only suggested: a guess earns no logo.

category.description: A group from the ledger taxonomy with its detail: Food or Food:Groceries. Null only where no ledger account says, such as a plan.

spend_kind.description: Fixed cost, variable spending or a large one-off, set on the server. snapshot-v2.md, "Fixed, variable, one-off". Absent on a row from a build before this field.

spend_kind_reason.description: Why, as a code. spend.allocation.reasons has the words.

spend_kind_source.description: rule: worked out. owner: a correction with spend_kind said so.

corrections_seq.description: Distinct correction lines this snapshot includes, revokes too. It only grows, so the app can drop pending corrections up to it.

Payees.description: Who am I paying, and who still needs a name?

category.description: A group from the ledger taxonomy with its detail: Food or Food:Groceries. Null only where no ledger account says, such as a plan.

brand.description: Null while the merchant is unnamed or only suggested: a guess earns no logo.

spread_state.description: Fixed bills have no ±. `amount.spread` is present only when measured.

price_change_bp.description: Latest amount against the same month a year ago. Null with no amount a year ago.

CardBill.description: One live card's last statement bill and whether a payment for it shows. Matching only: no amount moves. See snapshot-v2.md, Card bill status.

id.description: The card's short label as a link: `#/bills/<id>`.

due.description: Paise: the last statement's total due.

paid.description: Paise of payments since the statement date, the sum of `payments`. May exceed `due`.

paid_date.description: The day the bill was covered, or for part_paid the latest payment. Null otherwise.

confidence.description: statement: a bank statement shows every payment. provisional: messages show it, or show none yet. estimate: a payment matched on nearness, or one that named no card.

may_be_paid.description: Paise of a bank payment close to this card's balance that is not proven to be for it. Counts nothing.

via.description: card: the card's own record. bank: a bank debit named for this card. unnamed: part of a payment that named no card, set against this bill; its date is null.

cards.description: Added 2026-11-06, additive: one row per live card with a statement. Optional, so older snapshots stay valid.

paid_this_month.description: The sum of `paid`. Unlike v1, it counts card bills.

Bills.description: What is due, and what repeats?

asset_class.description: From the instrument id. Null when it does not say. EPF, PPF, FD and gold have no input yet.

liquid.description: Could be sold within a week. Null when the class is unknown.

estimated.description: Show `Est` only when true. Priced holdings are false, whatever `value.confidence` says.

brand.description: Null while the merchant is unnamed or only suggested: a guess earns no logo.

Holding.description: One holding. `value` is in rupees; `value_usd` is its native value when held in dollars.

parts.description: Where the month's money came from, when a source beyond the bank is connected. Additive.

estimate.description: True when no dollar rate from around the date exists.

partial.description: Some connected source doesn't cover this month, so the figure may be low. Additive.

state.description: bank_transfers: contributions and put_in come from the ledger. connected_sources: from the ledger and funding documents. none: nothing can say what went in.

basis.description: What the monthly figures can and cannot see, in plain words.

covered_months.description: Months every connected source covers, with this one so far if they all reach today; with only the bank, the months a statement covers. A month here with no contribution was ₹0; one outside is not known.

partial_months.description: Months some connected source covers or has money in, but not all: never ₹0. Additive.

sources.description: Each connected source and the dates it covers. Additive.

put_in_source.description: Where monthly put-in comes from. Additive.

invested.description: The "put in" for the portfolio card: value - invested = gain. `put_in` and `net_cash_in` measure bank money and do not pair with gain.

Invest.description: What do I hold, and what did I put in? Null until holdings exports exist: hidden, never zero.

PlanInputs.description: The inputs a client-side plan needs. Plans are entered and only ever change projections.

out_of_scope.description: Accounts the owner no longer uses: still shown, provisional, and not counted by the statement gates.

accepted_gaps.description: Statement gaps the owner accepted: they warn instead of block.

Health.description: Can I trust this? Counts only.

InvestSlice.description: Value by platform, currency or country. Slices of one kind sum to the total.

GainSince.description: Gain counted from when data is reliable, always shown with `since`. Value now, less value at `since`, less net cash and vests after it. RSU vests are separate here and never cash.

InvestWeek.description: Net bank money into platforms for one week, Monday-dated. Never includes vests.

InvestMovement.description: One bank payment to or from a platform. Into the platform is positive.

InvestVest.description: RSU shares received. Not cash; never part of net_cash_in or movements.

InvestEvent.description: A market event. `upcoming` dates are approximate. Text comes from the owner's events file.

InvestStatus.description: Whether the card's value is current. `state` is none when nothing is held. Age is in each figure's as_of.

Absent.description: Why a field is null. `path` uses [] for every item of a list.

kind.description: First match wins, m the median, h the ±, lo = m - h: sell m < hard; dip m < soft; could lo < hard; just lo < soft; fits otherwise. Null when m is at or above soft and h is unknown.

earned.description: Green must be earned: fits, and lo beats 10 of the last 12 month-ends; g2 also at least twice the best. Under 12 month-ends, never.

CashStatus.description: The one status rule for cash against the cushions. `Figure.status` is not used on these figures.

Cushions.description: The owner's values from plan storage, else status rules.

late.description: Expected before as_of and not seen, so dated today.

spread.description: The ±, in paise: the width that holds 8 of each 10 past misses, a rule and not a promise. Unrounded; the app rounds for show.

method.description: Which width made it. The back-test replaces this named input later.

step.description: The ladder against usual: z = (now - median) / ±, and the difference must be at least ₹2,000.

UsualBand.description: Median and ± over the last 12 complete months, at the same point in the month. Null with under 6 months: no number, no colour.

time.description: IST clock time where an SMS gave one. A statement alone gives a date.

ReviewPayment.description: A payment as a memory cue, newest first, up to 12.

category.description: A group from the ledger taxonomy with its detail: Food or Food:Groceries. Null only where no ledger account says, such as a plan.

brand.description: Null while the merchant is unnamed or only suggested: a guess earns no logo.

ReturnSince.description: Price change in the holding's own currency since `since`: always shown with that date. Not a yearly return.

Buckets.description: Holdings in paise for Plan. `safe` is null: see `absent`.

MonthSoFar.description: The Line's past row: all bank money this month.

Expense.description: A saved big expense, read back from the fold of plan.events.v1. Cancelled ones stay, as history.

spread.description: Not known from any source today.

YearRow.description: One month, in paise. open + salary + vests_in_cash - outgo - invest - bills - planned = end. Row 0 is Likely left, unrounded, with plans taken off.

before_salary.description: The year again with row 0 as `forecast.before_salary`. Present when that figure is.

PlanYear.description: What the app's Plan engine needs, in paise, and 12 rows worked out from it. `rows` is empty when a needed input is null: see `absent`.

complete.description: False: some of it is not in the data or has not happened. Never show its sum as whole.

proven_bp.description: Share of these rupees on a statement.

Reports.description: Months from April of the last financial year. Cash flow and profit and loss sum `months`; Audit lists every line of income, spending and investing.

date.description: The figure's day: the day before the next salary, or the month's last day when salary timing is unknown. Never before as_of.

date_reason.description: Why `date` is the month's last day. Null when it follows the salary.

figure.description: cash - due - planned_moves - usual_spend, rounded to the rule's step. No salary is ever in it. Null when history is too short.

salary.description: The next salary: the Salary row after the figure. Null without a regular salary.

planned_moves.description: Repeating transfers to investing dated up to `date`. Known moves only: a one-off is never predicted.

range.description: How the range on `figure` is made, and how often it has held. Absent with no figure.

MovedSoFar.description: Paid to investing this month so far. Already out of cash, so already in the figure.

UnplannedMoves.description: Transfers to investing no repeating payment explains, over the last 12 covered months. NOT in the figure or its ±: any that happens lowers the real balance by that amount. Must be shown beside the figure when months_with is above 0.

PaymentUnmatched.description: Bank debits classed as card payments that could name no card: part or round payments, or equal bills on two cards. Off the total once. Show as a line: "payment not yet matched to a card".

Shortfall.description: Out of money, on the known schedule: snapshot-v2.md. Null with too little history to know a schedule.

change.description: Paise, signed: up or down from the previous bar.

CurvePoints.description: [day of month, running total in paise], only on days the total changes. Before the first point it is 0.

one_off.description: Paise of one-offs inside points and total, and left out of the median.

median.description: Median per day of the past months without their one-offs. Null with too few months.

MonthCurves.description: Running totals by day of month, for all spending and each group. snapshot-v2.md.

Rolling.description: Spend's opening: everyday spending in the running last 30 days against the usual 30 days. snapshot-v2.md.

mover.description: The group that changed this total most from the previous bar drawn. Null on a bar with no total, the first drawn, or when no group changed. Absent on a build from before this field.

everyday.description: The same 30 days and the same usual, both without one-offs (`spend_kind`), so the page compares like with like. snapshot-v2.md.

FixedCost.description: One payee in the fixed list. Amounts in paise.

key.description: What a correction names: the merchant's alias key, or this payment.

spend_kind_reason.description: Why, as a code. spend.allocation.reasons has the words.

spend_kind_source.description: rule: worked out. owner: a correction with spend_kind said so.

state.description: changed, twice and missing ask for attention. The rest stay quiet.

month.description: The latest month paid: for a rent, the month it is for.

amount.description: What that month came to. For a split rent, the owner's share.

usual.description: Median of up to 6 earlier months, leaving out any paid twice. Null with none.

share.description: This is a share of a payment split with others.

SpendAllocation.description: How Spend separates fixed costs, variable spending and large one-offs. snapshot-v2.md.

one_off_threshold.description: The one-off line used in this build, in paise.

monthly.description: This month's fixed costs: paid so far, plus what is still to come at its usual.

verdict.description: same: nothing asks for attention. Null: no history to compare with.

window.description: What the running 30 days held of each kind. everyday is the part inside spend.rolling.spent, and sums to it.

method.description: Names the method, so an old range and a new one cannot be confused.

months.description: Past months that set the width.

tested.description: Past months each judged by a range made only from the months before it.

held.description: Of those, how many real balances landed inside.

held_usual.description: The same with moves to investing and one-offs added back: how many usual months landed inside.

UsualRange.description: Measured in every build. The app words its label from these, so a stated hit rate cannot outlive its evidence.

date.description: When it falls due, or for rent and a share back, when it usually moves.

amount.description: Out of the bank. A share coming back is negative.

charges_so_far.description: A card's charges since its last statement, for an estimated bill.

end.description: The day before the salary after it.

cards_within_days.description: Three in four card bills left within this many days of salary, in the last 6 pay cycles. Null with too few.

card_total.description: The card rows alone. Bills reads this.

left.description: Likely left, plus the salary, less `total`. No everyday spending after salary is in it.
